scope: 91 previously qualified historical parent turn entries SOXX, SMH, QQQ, AMD, NVDA, MU, INTC, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, XLV, XLE. Exclude AVGO missing 15m warmup.
source: existing private Terminal 5m and15m RTH OHLCV snapshots, receipt/source SHA verified; data rights/no PIT/actual quotes not qualified
baseline: 52 RTH hour timed exit or original1.5% hard stop whichever first, 25% partial at2%, next-open fills and5bp/side fees
treatment: For any position still open after exactly 3 observed RTH hours, unconditionally sell all residual at NEXT observed 5m opening; original stop/partial preempts. Compare same entry counterfactual vs baseline.
oracle: With hindsight choose max(base,treatment) separately on each alive trade. This is an upper bound on information value of one binary exit-at-3h decision, not a tradeable strategy or ultimate optimal stopping bound.
measure: which positions already stopped before three hours
max possible mean return gain from oracle at 3h per original entry
economic sacrifices if all live positions exited
binary red (3h close below entry) vs green classification table
cost-sensitive confusion matrix and rank AUC for 3h return; no fitted threshold, no parameter search
asset cluster and calendar-week block descriptives
source_gaps: KLAC seven 5m missing source bars; refuse/censor any entry-to-either-counterfactual-exit path crossing one. Do not fill.
